reEndorsement: The T02 receipt target-hash refresh is an integrity re-pin after an owner-directed verifier behaviour change. It does not re-approve, broaden, or add implementation authority, and it does not weaken any gate outside GitHub Actions. Residual property, stated on purpose: GITHUB_ACTIONS is an environment variable, so a local operator can set it to skip the baseline file read; the recorded digest binding still holds in that case, only the local-file proof is skipped. Every environment-based CI detection shares this property; the sanctioned local use is the documented GITHUB_ACTIONS=true npm run test:plans on a machine that does not hold the baseline.
